meta.name: aws-cdk-development
meta.description: AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) expert for building cloud infrastructure with TypeScript/Python. Use when creating CDK stacks, defining CDK constructs, implementing infrastructure as code, or when the user mentions CDK, CloudFormation, IaC, cdk synth, cdk deploy, or wants to define AWS infrastructure programmatically. Covers CDK app structure, construct patterns, stack composition, and deployment workflows.

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage AWS resources via code and want automated deployment.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会借助 AWS 文档 MCP 核实 AWS 最新信息,并用 CDK 最佳实践编写、校验和部署 TypeScript/Python 的云基础设施代码。
howto.when: 当用户提到 CDK、CloudFormation、IaC 等关键词,或要求用代码定义 AWS 基础设施、创建或重构 CDK stack 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 CDK 写一个 S3 存储桶的 stack
say.note: Claude 会生成 stack 并检查资源命名。

say.text: 用 NodejsFunction 在 CDK 里定义 Lambda 函数
部署前用 cdk-nag 检查我的 CDK 配置
say.note: Claude 会加入 cdk-nag 做合成时校验。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses AWS Documentation MCP to verify latest AWS info and follows CDK best practices to write, validate, and deploy TypeScript/Python cloud infrastructure code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions CDK, CloudFormation, IaC, or asks to define AWS infrastructure programmatically, create, or refactor CDK stacks.

say_en.text: Help me create an S3 bucket stack using CDK.
say_en.note: Claude generates the stack and checks resource naming.

say_en.text: Define a Lambda function in CDK using NodejsFunction.
say_en.note: Claude uses the Lambda Node.js construct and handles bundling.

say_en.text: Check my CDK configuration with cdk-nag before deployment.
say_en.note: Claude adds cdk-nag and runs synthesis validation.
